environment.description: Same Jenkins runner deployed in EKS (v1.28) with Istio service mesh (v1.20.2). The pipeline pod has a Kyverno ClusterPolicy (generate-sri-configmap) that injects an initContainer which pre-fetches and pins the manifest.json into a read-only emptyDir volume at /etc/pipeline/manifest-cache/ before the main container starts. The Istio sidecar enforces a DestinationRule with ISTIO_MUTUAL TLS mode for all egress to *.internal hosts, and a ServiceEntry restricts the build-scripts.internal resolution to a specific VirtualService endpoint backed by a known-good registry pod with a PeerAuthentication policy requiring mTLS. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate (K8sScriptIntegrityRequired) validates that any script fetched during pipeline execution has a corresponding sha384 entry in the pre-pinned manifest ConfigMap - if the manifest fetch fails (returning null/empty), the Gatekeeper admission webhook rejects the pod's completion status via a sidecar audit container that posts to the Kubernetes API, causing the pipeline step to be marked failed before subprocess execution occurs.

config.sri_enforcement: initContainer pre-pins manifest to read-only volume; Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate K8sScriptIntegrityRequired rejects execution if integrity_map is null/empty
config.audit_sidecar: Monitors script execution attempts, blocks completion if integrity validation is bypassed
config.dns: Istio DNS proxying with ServiceEntry-only resolution
